# Getting Ready for AICatalyst 2026

With less than a month to go until September 4th and the UKRI AICatalyst Training Conference it’s all systems go behind the scenes to get everything together ready for you.
The event will be full of explorations of careful and critical use of AI in Biosciences, but also an opportunity for you to get to know other researchers using those techniques too!

![The York Guildhall](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UKRI-Digital-Research-Skills-Catalyst/digital-skills-website/refs/heads/main/assets/guildhall.png){width=800}

# **Here’s 5 things to look forward to at AICatalyst 2026!**

## Joining the Padlet
By now you should have had an email with the conference Padlet link. Padlet is an easy to use platform for sharing snippets of information. On there you can find important information about the day such as finding the venue, schedules, and poster lists, as well as speaker and delegate bios. Why not add your bio ahead of the conference, it’ll help people with similar interests find you and chat!

## Expert-led Workshops
You should also have been informed about which session you’ve been assigned to. Whether it is using AI for image analysis or for multi-omics, you’ll be trained in cutting edge skills and knowledge that is pioneering in the field. All our sessions are fully booked out, so be sure to bring a fully charged laptop as plug sockets may be limited!

## Browsing the Poster Presentations
Lunch time is also poster session time! Have a browse of the different posters on the Padlet and go along and chat to the poster presenters about their work. The massive range of topics is a sure indicator of the breadth of expertise at the conference, so be ready to make some new network contacts with the presenters!

## Meet our exhibitors
In addition to our workshops and posters we also have three exhibitor stands to check out! These are AIBIO-UK (who part funded the conference), ScryptIQ (who are also delivering a workshop), and MORF-BIO. Chat with AIBIO about getting involved in the UK’s AI in the Bioscience community, talk with ScryptIQ about bespoke AI training, and check out MORF’s Multi-omics visualisation tools.

## Networking at Trembling Madness
House of Trembling Madness is one of York’s most popular gems, and AICatalyst has booked out the entire basement floor! If you don’t have to dash for a train immediately then do join us for networking just a few doors down from the Guildhall in a cosy atmosphere. After all you are the nascent AI Bioscientist community!

**We’ll see you all on the 4th September!**
